{
  echo "=== GITHUB CONTEXT ==="
  echo "GITHUB_REPOSITORY=$GITHUB_REPOSITORY"

  echo
  echo "=== STATUS ==="
  git status --short --branch
  echo
  echo "=== REMOTES ==="

  echo
  echo "=== REFS ==="
  git show-ref

  echo "=== RECENT HISTORY ==="

} > runtime/generated/evidence/git-topology.txt

{
  echo "BASE_SHA=$BASE_SHA"
  echo "BASE_COMMIT:"
  git show -s --format=fuller "$BASE_SHA"
  echo
  echo "HEAD_COMMIT:"
  git show -s --format=fuller HEAD
  echo

set +e

BASE_SHA="${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}"
HEAD_SHA="${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}"

OUT="runtime/generated/evidence/git-diff-comparison.txt"

{
  echo "=================================================="
  echo "EXACT PR BASE / HEAD"
  echo "=================================================="
  echo "BASE=$BASE_SHA"
  echo "HEAD=$HEAD_SHA"
  echo

  echo "=================================================="
  echo "A: THREE-DOT BASE...HEAD"
  echo "=================================================="
  git diff --name-only "$BASE_SHA...$HEAD_SHA"
  echo
  echo "COUNT:"
  git diff --name-only "$BASE_SHA...$HEAD_SHA" | wc -l
  echo

  echo "=================================================="
  echo "B: TWO-TREE BASE HEAD"
  echo "=================================================="
  git diff --name-only "$BASE_SHA" "$HEAD_SHA"
  echo
  echo "COUNT:"
  git diff --name-only "$BASE_SHA" "$HEAD_SHA" | wc -l
  echo

  echo "=================================================="
  echo "C: MERGE-BASE...HEAD"
  echo "=================================================="
  MERGE_BASE="$(git merge-base "$HEAD_SHA" "$BASE_SHA")"
  echo "MERGE_BASE=$MERGE_BASE"
  git diff --name-only "$MERGE_BASE...$HEAD_SHA"
  echo
  echo "COUNT:"
  git diff --name-only "$MERGE_BASE...$HEAD_SHA" | wc -l
  echo

  echo "=================================================="
  echo "D: GITHUB_BASE_REF"
  echo "=================================================="
  if [ -n "${GITHUB_BASE_REF:-}" ]; then
    git diff --name-only "origin/$GITHUB_BASE_REF...$HEAD_SHA"
    echo
    echo "COUNT:"
    git diff --name-only "origin/$GITHUB_BASE_REF...$HEAD_SHA" | wc -l
  else
    echo "GITHUB_BASE_REF is empty"
  fi
} > "$OUT"

exit 0

python - <<'PY'

{

SUMMARY="backend/tests/generated/mutation/mutation-summary.json"
if [ ! -f "$SUMMARY" ]; then
  echo "mutation_execution_status=INFRASTRUCTURE_FAILURE" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
  echo "mutation_evaluated=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
  echo "mutation_score=N/A" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
  echo "mutation_killed=0" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
  echo "mutation_survived=0" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
  echo "mutation_threshold=80" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
  echo "mutation_exit_code=1" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
  echo "mutation_reason=mutation-summary.json was not produced (execution did not complete)" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
  exit 0
fi
EXEC=$(jq -r '.execution_status' "$SUMMARY")
CLSS=$(jq -r '.classification_status' "$SUMMARY")
EVID=$(jq -r '.evidence_complete' "$SUMMARY")
SCORE=$(jq -r '.mutation_score' "$SUMMARY")
KILLED=$(jq -r '.killed' "$SUMMARY")
SURVIVED=$(jq -r '.survived' "$SUMMARY")
THRESH=$(jq -r '.threshold_percent' "$SUMMARY")
echo "mutation_execution_status=$EXEC" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
echo "mutation_killed=$KILLED" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
echo "mutation_survived=$SURVIVED" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
echo "mutation_threshold=$THRESH" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
if [ "$EXEC" = "PASS" ] && [ "$CLSS" = "PASS" ] && [ "$EVID" = "true" ]; then
  echo "mutation_evaluated=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
  echo "mutation_score=$SCORE" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
  if [ "$SCORE" != "null" ] && [ "$(echo "$SCORE >= $THRESH" | bc)" -eq 1 ]; then
    echo "mutation_exit_code=0" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
    echo "mutation_reason=Mutation score meets threshold" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
  else
    echo "mutation_exit_code=2" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
    echo "mutation_reason=Mutation score below threshold" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
  fi
else
  # Gate A or B failed: mutation was NOT evaluated. Never a 0% score.
  echo "mutation_evaluated=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
  echo "mutation_score=N/A" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
  echo "mutation_exit_code=1" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
  echo "mutation_reason=Mutation testing was not evaluated — execution/evidence integrity failed (no score computed)" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
fi

echo "## ${{ github.workflow }} — Run #${{ github.run_number }}" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
echo "" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
echo "### Mutation Testing Results" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
echo "" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
echo "| Metric       | Value |" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
echo "|--------------|-------|" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
echo "| Score        | ${{ steps.mutation.outputs.mutation_score }}% |" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
echo "| Evaluated    | ${{ steps.mutation.outputs.mutation_evaluated }} |" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
echo "| Killed       | ${{ steps.mutation.outputs.mutation_killed }} |" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
echo "| Survived     | ${{ steps.mutation.outputs.mutation_survived }} |" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
echo "| Threshold    | ${{ steps.mutation.outputs.mutation_threshold }}% |" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
echo "| Exec status  | ${{ steps.mutation.outputs.mutation_execution_status }} |" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
echo "" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY

if [ "${{ steps.mutation.outputs.mutation_evaluated }}" = "true" ] && [ "${{ steps.mutation.outputs.mutation_exit_code }}" = "0" ]; then
  echo "✅ Mutation score meets threshold" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
elif [ "${{ steps.mutation.outputs.mutation_evaluated }}" = "true" ]; then
  echo "❌ Mutation score below threshold" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
else
  echo "⚠️ MUTATION NOT EVALUATED — ${{ steps.mutation.outputs.mutation_reason }}" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
  echo "" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
  echo "No mutation score was computed. This is an infrastructure/evidence" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
  echo "failure, NOT a 0% quality result." >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
fi
echo "" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY

python runtime/verify.py status >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY

CODE="${{ steps.mutation.outputs.mutation_exit_code }}"
if [ "$CODE" = "0" ]; then
  echo "✅ Mutation quality gate passed"
  exit 0
elif [ "${{ steps.mutation.outputs.mutation_evaluated }}" = "true" ]; then
  echo "❌ Mutation score below threshold (${{ steps.mutation.outputs.mutation_score }}% < ${{ steps.mutation.outputs.mutation_threshold }}%)"
  exit 2
else
  echo "❌ ${{ steps.mutation.outputs.mutation_reason }}"
  exit 1
fi

echo "" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY

echo "**Security** tab (code scanning) and as PR check annotations." >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
